Important

Past performance, real or simulated, does not guarantee future results. Trading leveraged gold contracts carries a high risk of loss, and losses can be larger than those shown. Only trade with money you can afford to lose, at least 20% of it.

How this was tested

Historical tests of FTM MACHINE in MetaTrader 5, with all profits reinvested and leverage 1:100. Every trade has a stop loss and is sized from the account balance according to the risk profile.

  • Gold (XAUUSD): 1 January 2020 to 8 October 2026, starting balances from $500 to $1M.
  • Bitcoin (BTCUSD): 1 January 2020 to 16 October 2026 at FundedNext, one-minute price data with the broker's real spread, commission and swap, starting balances from $1k to $100k.
  • USD/JPY (USDJPY): 1 January 2020 to 16 October 2026 at FundedNext, one-minute price data with the broker's real spread, commission and swap, starting balance $100,000.
  • US Tech 100 (NDX100): 1 November 2022 to 16 October 2026 at FundedNext (all the history the broker has for this market), one-minute price data with the broker's real spread, commission and swap, starting balance $100,000.

Important

Past performance, real or simulated, does not guarantee future results. Trading leveraged gold, Bitcoin, currency and stock index contracts carries a high risk of loss, and losses can be larger than those shown. Only trade with money you can afford to lose, at least 20% of it.
